name: Cleveland
takeaway: Cleveland SOPEC term ends July 2026 — repricing window opens in a few months. Already up from an estimated 7.8¢ baseline.
hook: Cleveland's SOPEC contract is up mid-summer — have you looked at what the city program reprices to after July?
notes: SOPEC program rate 9.236¢/kWh Aug 2025–Jul 2026. Previous rate estimated ~7.8¢. Large commercial accounts in Cleveland may benefit from competitive supply before term ends.

name: Parma
takeaway: NOPEC rate jumps from 8.999¢ to 9.999¢ in June 2026 — an 11% hit landing in 30 days. Parma businesses are already feeling the prior cycle increase.
hook: Are you aware Parma's NOPEC rate goes up another cent next month — to nearly 10¢?
notes: NOPEC standard rate: 8.999¢ Jan–May 2026, rising to 9.999¢ June 2026. Prior cycle approx 7.0¢. Rate has increased ~43% over two cycles.

name: Strongsville

hook: Strongsville's on NOPEC — that rate is going up again June 1st. Have you had a chance to review your supply contract?
notes: NOPEC standard rate 8.999¢ rising to 9.999¢ June 2026. Strong commercial/industrial corridor along Route 82 and I-71.

name: Euclid

hook: Euclid businesses on NOPEC are looking at another rate hike next month — worth a conversation before June?
notes: NOPEC territory, The Illuminating Company. Industrial base along Euclid Avenue and Lakeshore corridor.

name: Solon

notes: Dense industrial park presence (Solon Industrial Parkway corridor). NOPEC standard rate 8.999¢ → 9.999¢ June 2026.
